verdict.rationale: Airbyte publishes a pricing page with a credit-based model. A credit-to-dollar ratio is implied (400 credits = $2,000 of usage), and tier features such as SSO, RBAC and 15-minute syncs are listed. However, nothing in the evidence explains how credits are consumed per source (rows, GB or connector type), so a data platform lead cannot estimate a new source's cost before connecting it. Missing for 10: documented credit consumption rates per source or volume, a cost estimator or calculator, evidence of predictability from users.

support.subject: As a data platform lead, the pricing model is published and predictable — I can estimate what a new source costs before connecting it

citations.quote: Start with a 30-day free trial. 400 credits included ($2,000 of usage).
